decision.observation: Manual Generator info panel open in POWER panel. 'Select Blueprint' shows skull icon at pixel ~(277,457). 'Select Metal Ore' shows material box with '200' required and '1180' available. Food 18,400 kcal (up from 17,600). One dupe visible at right edge. decision.hypothesis: The info panel 'Select Blueprint' icon and 'Select Metal Ore' box have been clicked many times without entering placement mode. The correct ONI build flow is: click building icon in build panel -> info tooltip appears -> click the MATERIAL BOX (the '200' box showing required/available) to SELECT the material -> placement cursor activates. The material box showing '200' on top at pixel ~(277, 575) may need to be the click target, but it has also been tried. Looking at the screenshot: the material box with '200' label is at pixel (277, 565) = normalized (0.216, 0.785). The skull image INSIDE the 'Select Blueprint' box is at pixel (277, 457) = (0.216, 0.635). None of these have worked. NEW APPROACH: Close the info panel by pressing Escape, then zoom in on the POWER panel icons to see them more clearly, and click the Manual Generator icon at a different position.
decision.memory: CRITICAL REALIZATION: In ONI, clicking a building icon opens its info/tooltip panel. The PLACEMENT MODE is activated by clicking the building image in the 'Select Blueprint' section. Neither clicking the blueprint skull nor the material box has worked after 20+ attempts. NEW STRATEGY: Close everything with Escape, zoom in (scroll up) to make the game world larger, then try clicking the Manual Generator icon in the POWER panel at the very bottom. The build panel icons should be larger when zoomed in, making them easier to click. Escape with no tool active opens Pause Menu - must avoid. Instead press G to activate Dig tool first, then Escape to close it safely, leaving no tool active.
